svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — We can’t afford to save any more
svg.desc: Black-and-white pen-and-ink newspaper cartoon in a suburban front yard on Black Friday. A fictional courier from Speedy Parcels staggers up the garden path behind a wobbling tower of boxes labelled 50% off, Sale, Fragile, Buy 2 Save and an upside-down This Way Up. On the verandah a fictional shopper with bags holds up her phone and says: another $920 saved, love! In the doorway her weary partner holds a mug of tea. A gum tree, picket fence, a magpie, a letterbox stuffed with sale catalogues and a wheelie bin full of flattened boxes fill the scene. Caption: We can’t afford to save any more.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
“WE CAN’T AFFORD TO SAVE ANY MORE.”
Source: ARC–Roy Morgan, 11 November 2026 — Australians tipped to spend a record $7.2 billion over the Black Friday weekend.
